s2_rng.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM or trailing newline; labels are ASCII subset
s2_rng.integer_extraction: first 8 digest bytes interpreted as unsigned little-endian uint64
s2_rng.draw: 9999x16 uint8 integers in [0,2), C row-major draw order; 0 maps to -1 and 1 maps to +1

i8.stimulated_paths: B APL-on, B APL-off, and each of 39 C APL-on paths
i8.unit: one path x odor x trial
i8.rate_vector: q=response-window integral divided by 500 ms over 1907 covered KCs
i8.active_fraction_error: absolute difference of covered-KC active fractions
i8.active_jaccard: ordinary Jaccard; both empty is 1 only for I8 numerical identity, exactly one empty is 0
i8.aggregation: maximum active-fraction error, maximum NRMSE, and minimum Jaccard over every unit; no averaging
i8.halving: for each unit use common denominator max(RMS(q_0.025),0.05): E_coarse=NRMSE(q_0.1,q_0.05), E_fine=NRMSE(q_0.05,q_0.025); pass if both <=1e-4, otherwise E_fine<=0.6*E_coarse
i8.classification_rule: the five booleans must be identical at all three dt values
i8.zero_rule: ZERO is checked separately under I7 and I8; all continuous outputs must be finite and numerical active sets must be identical across dt

rq_verdict.meaning: RQ passed I1-I8 and B passed S1-S4; RT remains sealed and no final M1 success is claimed

zero.input: exact float64 zero vector for all 145 PNs at every time step

control_failure_semantics.b_missing_or_nonfinite: S1/S2 failure or implementation failure according to cause; never omit
control_failure_semantics.c_finite_but_undefined_scientific_t_sep: retain control and assign T_C=+infinity for S5 rank/effect calculations; report reason; never replace or redraw
control_failure_semantics.s5_scope: B and all 39 fixed C controls at a given dt
control_failure_semantics.s4_scope: paired B APL-on versus B APL-off only

reseal_plan.v4_action: do not modify, delete, rename, decrypt, or overwrite
reseal_plan.supersession_record: new v5 sidecar references hashes of all v4 public manifests and labels them SUPERSEDED_PROTOCOL_NOT_RUN
